captions.detailed: A realistic floor-standing bicycle or garage pump featuring a tall, cylindrical red barrel mounted on a wide, black dual-foot base. A silver metallic piston rod extends upwards from the top of the barrel, capped with a black T-handle assembly. A flexible black hose runs along the side of the barrel, secured by a clip, while a small analog pressure gauge is positioned near the base. The piston rod slides vertically relative to the red barrel, the grip sleeve on the T-handle rotates continuously around its axis, and the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a garage floor pump with a red barrel, a black dual-foot base, a silver piston rod, and a black T-handle. Incorporate a side-mounted black hose with a clip, an analog pressure gauge near the base, and define joints for the vertical prismatic movement of the piston, the continuous rotation of the handle grip, and the rotational movement of the pressure gauge needle.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining several key parts. First, the base is created using a combination of boxes and cylinders to form the foot pads and the lower connection block. The barrel is built as a tall, red cylinder with a black cap. The pressure gauge is modeled as a small cylinder with a rotating pointer needle. The piston rod is a thin silver cylinder, which is connected to a black T-handle consisting of a central block and a horizontal crossbar. A continuous sleeve grip is added to the crossbar. Finally, the flexible hose is approximated with a swept profile or combined cylinders along the side of the barrel. Prismatic, revolute, and continuous joints are defined to link the base, barrel, piston, handle grip, and gauge needle.
